name_reason: Name is already fully compliant: data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with domain=chapter, descriptor=ch16_end_scene_char_pos_y_table. '16' is a valid chapter ID (range 01-30, chapter 16 = Ice Plain battle), not address residue; 'ch16' and 'end_scene' are semantic. '_table' correctly reflects the array/table datatype. No Ghidra address residue suffix (table sits at 0x52193 but name carries no 0x52193/_52193).
purpose: Per-character Y tile coordinate table (16 entries) used to place chars 0..0xF on the map for the chapter 16 (Ice Plain battle / 冰原之戰) end scene.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_chapter_16_end copies all 16 bytes onto the stack (4x MOVSD) and passes the block as the pos_y argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which indexes it [char_idx] (one byte per char, stride 1) and stores each into runtime_char.bPos_y for chars 0..0xF. Paired with the X-coordinate table data_fd2_chapter_ch16_end_scene_char_pos_x_table @ 0x52183 immediately preceding it.
element_semantics: element [char_idx] = Y tile coordinate for runtime character char_idx (0..15) in the chapter 16 end scene. Values: 28,27,27,27,27,28,28,28,27,28,28,28,29,29,29,29 (0x1C,0x1B,0x1B,0x1B,0x1B,0x1C,0x1C,0x1C,0x1B,0x1C,0x1C,0x1C,0x1D,0x1D,0x1D,0x1D).
notes: Verified via Ghidra: exactly one xref (READ @ 0x23a3b + DATA @ 0x23a36, both in fd2_chapter_16_end), zero writers => const. read_memory at 0x52193 (16 bytes) byte-identical to src line 113 initializer. Datatype in Ghidra = byte[16] len=16, matches src const uint8[16]. src comment block (chtab2.c lines 98-111) already precise/accurate/complete => comment_verdict=keep, chtab2.c not modified. Ghidra had documentation misplaced in PRE_COMMENT with PLATE_COMMENT null; per project data-plate convention (PLATE_COMMENT only) created a proper PLATE_COMMENT (content per src) via run_script_inline and cleared the misplaced PRE_COMMENT. ghidra_plate_action=created.
